messages:
maria: Anyone else seeing a spike of 502s on hostedapi-us-west-2 starting ~08:15 UTC? Customer hit a bunch of small chat calls, all 502s.
ajay: yep saw alerts. 502s from edge gateway (envoy) - LB returned 502 upstream error. correlated with auth header rotation job at 08:12
sara: customer reported trace id: trace-9a8b7c2f. They say simple prompts, short responses. Can we repro quickly?
ajay: tried repro locally, got 502 consistently when adding X-Redwood-Billing header containing utf8 chars. Without the header, 200 OK
maria: interesting — paste of my curl test below

``
curl -v \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Billing: acct=acme; note=José" \n  https://api.hosted.redwood.ai/v1/chat
``

ajay: envoy access log shows upstream reset + envoy error "invalid header value" for that header. looks like auth-rotation-v2 converted base64 blob back to raw UTF-8 which Envoy rejects when proxying upstream -> 502
sara: this is a paying customer on tier=enterprise, they're seeing user-facing errors. CS is pinging them. urgent please
maria: short-term mitigations: 1) strip X-Redwood-Billing at the edge before forwarding, 2) rollback auth-rotation-v2. I can push a header-strip rule to the auth proxy in us-west-2 now
ajay: long-term we should percent-encode or base64 header values, and add a CI test for non-ascii billing metadata. Also check other rotation paths (token refresh CLI)
deploy-bot: Started rollback: reverting auth-rotation-v2 -> auth-rotation-v1 in us-west-2 (canary stop)
maria: rollback applied, canary stopped at 08:27 UTC
ajay: confirmed: traffic in us-west-2 shows 200 OK for previously failing traces. error rate back to baseline in last 3m
sara: updated customer, applied account credits, asked if they'd like a post-mortem. they'll take the PM follow-up.
maria: follow-up actions: (a) add header validation + percent-encode in rotation tool, (b) add unit test sending non-ascii billing header, (c) add edge rule to drop unknown custom headers if malformed, (d) add dashboard for header-related 502s
sara: thanks team :thumbsup: we can close the escalation once monitoring holds for 30m
__notes: Thread shows short troubleshooting exchange for Envoy/edge 502s caused by auth header encoding introduced by a rotation. Messages are realistic short Slack messages, include a small curl repro snippet and deploy-bot notification.
